conventions.distance: d2DM is the horizontal distance from the mast to the UE. Every model clamps it to at least 10 m (the 38.901 lower bound); d3D = sqrt(d2D^2 + (hBsM - hUtM)^2). Beyond the validated range (5 km for 38.901 UMa/UMi NLOS and RMa NLOS, 10 km RMa LOS, 1 to 20 km for Hata) the formulas are extrapolated as written; that is a warning, never a refusal.
conventions.heights: hBsM is the antenna height above the tower-base ground, hUtM the UE height above the same ground (flat ground, spec D17).
conventions.tr38901: 3GPP TR 38.901 V17 Table 7.4.1-1, fc in GHz inside the formulas, c = 3.0e8. UMa: d'BP = 4 h'BS h'UT fc[Hz]/c with h' = h - hE, PL1 = 28 + 22 log10(d3D) + 20 log10(fc), PL2 = 28 + 40 log10(d3D) + 20 log10(fc) - 9 log10(d'BP^2 + (hBS - hUT)^2), NLOS' = 13.54 + 39.08 log10(d3D) + 20 log10(fc) - 0.6 (hUT - 1.5). UMi street canyon: same d'BP, PL1 = 32.4 + 21 log10(d3D) + 20 log10(fc), PL2 = 32.4 + 40 log10(d3D) + 20 log10(fc) - 9.5 log10(d'BP^2 + (hBS - hUT)^2), NLOS' = 35.3 log10(d3D) + 22.4 + 21.3 log10(fc) - 0.3 (hUT - 1.5). RMa: dBP = 2 pi hBS hUT fc[Hz]/c with actual heights, PL1(d) = 20 log10(40 pi d fc/3) + min(0.03 h^1.72, 10) log10(d) - min(0.044 h^1.72, 14.77) + 0.002 log10(h) d, PL2 = PL1(dBP) + 40 log10(d3D/dBP), NLOS' = 161.04 - 7.1 log10(W) + 7.5 log10(h) - (24.37 - 3.7 (h/hBS)^2) log10(hBS) + (43.42 - 3.1 log10(hBS)) (log10(d3D) - 3) + 20 log10(fc) - (3.2 (log10(11.75 hUT))^2 - 4.97), h = 5 m, W = 20 m. PL1 when d2D <= breakpoint, else PL2. PL_NLOS = max(PL_LOS, NLOS'). hE = 1 m: exact for UMi; for UMa the TR draws hE = 1 m with probability 1/(1 + C(d2D, hUT)) and C = 0 for hUT < 13 m, so 1 m is exact at the default 1.5 m UE and a simplification above 13 m. hUT below the scenario's UE range (UMa and UMi 1.5 m, RMa 1 m; Table 7.4.1-1 gives 1.5 to 22.5 m and 1 to 10 m) is clamped up to that lower bound everywhere in the formulas (d3D, breakpoint, NLOS, LOS probability), with a warning, never refused; hUtUsedM is the height used. UMa and UMi refuse hBS <= 1 m (no effective height). Frequency range: UMa and UMi 500 MHz to 100 GHz, RMa 500 MHz to 30 GHz; outside is refused.
conventions.losProbability: TR 38.901 Table 7.4.2-1 on d2D (clamped to 10 m). UMi: 1 for d2D <= 18 m, else 18/d2D + exp(-d2D/36)(1 - 18/d2D). UMa: 1 for d2D <= 18 m, else [18/d2D + exp(-d2D/63)(1 - 18/d2D)] [1 + C'(hUT) 5/4 (d2D/100)^3 exp(-d2D/150)], C' = 0 for hUT <= 13 m, ((hUT - 13)/10)^1.5 above. RMa: 1 for d2D <= 10 m, else exp(-(d2D - 10)/1000).
conventions.expected: pathLossDb for tr38901 is the expected path loss with LOS probability, combined in the dB domain: P_LOS PL_LOS + (1 - P_LOS) PL_NLOS (spec D14 'LOS probability averaged into an expected path loss'). The dB-domain mean is the planning convention; a linear-power mean would sit up to a few dB lower where P_LOS is mid-range.
conventions.hata: f in MHz, d in km, heights in m. a(hm): medium or small city (1.1 log10 f - 0.7) hm - (1.56 log10 f - 0.8); large city 8.29 (log10(1.54 hm))^2 - 1.1 below 300 MHz, else 3.2 (log10(11.75 hm))^2 - 4.97. Okumura-Hata urban = 69.55 + 26.16 log10 f - 13.82 log10 hb - a(hm) + (44.9 - 6.55 log10 hb) log10 d; suburban = urban - 2 (log10(f/28))^2 - 5.4; open = urban - 4.78 (log10 f)^2 + 18.33 log10 f - 40.94. COST-231 Hata = 46.3 + 33.9 log10 f - 13.82 log10 hb - a(hm) + (44.9 - 6.55 log10 hb) log10 d + Cm, Cm = 3 dB for urban-large (with the large-city a(hm)), else 0; suburban is the COST-231 medium-city formula as published; open applies the Okumura-Hata open-area correction (an extension, not in COST-231). Areas: urban-large, urban (medium city), suburban, open; when hataArea is null it follows the 38.901 environment: uma and umi urban, rma open. Both are floored at free space over d3D (the empirical fits go below free space near the mast, outside their 1 km validity). Okumura-Hata refuses f outside 150 to 1500 MHz, COST-231 outside 1500 to 2000 MHz (inclusive edges).
conventions.freeSpace: 20 log10(4 pi d3D f / c), c = 299792458 m/s (equal to 32.45 + 20 log10 f[MHz] + 20 log10 d[km] to 0.001 dB).
